curation.notes: GenomeTrakr isolate ISO000104797 (SEQSEQ000098727). Strain ECOL-19-VL-SD-OK-0007. Isolation: wound swab (Canis lupus familiaris) from unknown host (2019-02). Assembly not available - generate locally.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR10257703 && mv data/SRR10257703_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR10257703_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O1:H7. Check for K1 capsule genes (if present, likely ST95). ExPEC virulence genes expected: ibeA, hlyA, cnf1. ST may be ST95, ST59, or other B2 lineage depending on K1 status.
validation_instructions.mlst: Run mlst with 'ecoli' scheme. Expected ST95 (phylogroup B2). Accept exact match.

notes: ExPEC serotype O1:H7, often associated with ST95 neonatal meningitis strains when K1 capsule present. This isolate from dog wound (Oklahoma 2019) likely lacks K1. O1:H7 without K1 typically ST59 or other B2 lineages. Veterinary ExPEC.
